name: Doge
preview: Sarah: Cheers. Hope the sun turns up for you.

messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Bitcoin Dogecoin miner

45 cents is steep — that changes the whole picture. At that rate a 400W miner like the B30 burns about $130 a month in power, well past what 30 TH/s stacks. It's a lottery ticket, not income.

The honest fit at 45c is a low-watt unit: the DC02 at ~25W runs about $8 a month and still gets you Doge block shots.

What were you hoping to get out of it — steady sats, or the jackpot swing?
doge or bitcoin cash blocks

Doge, then. Bitcoin Cash is SHA-256, and the only unit we have that mines it is the PunkHash 70T — about 1.45 kW, which at 45c is roughly $470 a month. Not a fit.

For Doge blocks the DC02 is the sharpest per watt: 105 MH/s at ~25W, $239.99, in stock.

Where are you shipping — US or Europe?
europe
Opened a product

EU plug version is in stock at our Rotterdam warehouse — $239.99, ships within about 2 business days. Since it ships from inside the EU, import VAT is included in the price; you just add shipping at checkout, from $17.99.

Power at your 45c: roughly $8 a month.

Want me to build the cart?
not at the moment as were outside the EU and get additional charges but thanks anyway
Used the chat-interview skill

Understood — duties on delivery are real and we can't absorb them.

Before you go, one thing: what were you hoping the dual unit would do that a single-coin miner wouldn't?
I just think its cool to be able to mine 2 seperate coins that are on different algorithms

That's fair, two algorithms in one box is a genuinely different thing.

Would two small separate boxes scratch the same itch, or does it have to be the one unit?
it was good because I'm tight for space as I have 2 NerdQaxes

Makes sense — the DC02 is small, but it's still another box and another plug.

Last one: at 45 cents a kWh, what keeps the two NerdQaxes running for you?
I have a lage battery generater that I can charge by solar so there not always on as we don't get a lot of sun or heat lol

Three facts, that's my limit — thanks for the answers, genuinely useful.

Solar-and-battery changes the maths completely: off-grid hours cost you nothing, so low watts matter more than hashrate. That's the DC02's whole argument at 25W.

Good luck with the sun.
thanks very much, If I can organise some space I may come back for the DC02

Sounds good. It's here when you're ready: heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-miner-scrypt-dogecoin-litecoin — just note the EU plug is the only one outside the US, so type C/F.

Take care.
thank you and take care
Cheers. Hope the sun turns up for you.

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the + Dogecoin numbers for where you live.
